title: A single-cell atlas of the human substantia nigra reveals cell-specific pathways associated with neurological disorders
main_conclusions_short: PD GWAS risk enriched in dopaminergic-neuron-specific genes; no PD-risk association with microglia/astrocytes; SN oligodendrocyte/OPC enrichment for other neuro traits
notes: VERIFIED: GEO accession, 5 neurotypical donors, nuclei counts (PMC text). No PD donors: reference atlas with genetic-enrichment claims only. Per-cell labels on GEO not checked.

title: Single-cell sequencing of human midbrain reveals glial activation and a Parkinson-specific neuronal state
main_conclusions_short: Loss of DA neurons with a PD-specific CADPS2-high neuronal state; microglia and astrocyte activation/expansion in IPD; PD GWAS risk enriched in microglia and neurons
notes: VERIFIED: 6 IPD / 5 ctrl, 41,435 nuclei, GEO GSE157783 (PMC). Processed matrix assumed on GEO (not opened).

title: Single-cell genomic profiling of human dopamine neurons identifies a population that selectively degenerates in Parkinson's disease
regions: SNpc (DA-neuron NR4A2 FANS enrichment); dorsal striatum (controls, 4 donors, reference only)
main_conclusions_short: SOX6_AGTR1 DA subtype in ventral tier is most lost in PD; PD heritability enriched in AGTR1 DA neurons; TP53 and NR2F2 targets upregulated in vulnerable subtype
notes: VERIFIED: n=10 PD/LBD (PD and LBD combined; split not extracted) and 8 controls, nuclei counts, accessions (PMC). CELLxGENE per-class datasets carry author labels.

title: Molecular profiling of human substantia nigra identifies diverse neuron types associated with vulnerability in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: RIT2-enriched neuron cluster vulnerable in PD; diverse SN neuron types beyond DA neurons altered; T cells/fibroblasts/pericytes detected; reduced RIT2 implicated in pathogenesis
notes: VERIFIED: 32 donors (23 IPD, 9 ctrl) and nuclei count from PMC; HCA listing says 21 IPD + 1 LBD + 9 ctrl (discrepancy, note). Earlier bioRxiv 2022.03.25.485846. GEO statement says raw data; processed availability unverified.

title: Unravelling cell type-specific responses to Parkinson's Disease at single cell resolution
main_conclusions_short: Neuronal subpopulation loss in PD SNpc; PD-specific glial (astrocyte/microglia/oligodendrocyte) transcriptional responses; TH expression in non-neuronal SNpc cells
notes: VERIFIED: 15 PD/14 ctrl (Oregon Brain Bank), 83,484 nuclei, accessions (PMC). Conclusions summarized from abstract-level knowledge; check paper.

title: A single-nuclei paired multiomic analysis of the human midbrain reveals age- and Parkinson's disease-associated glial changes
main_conclusions_short: All glial types change with age; microglia and oligodendrocytes further altered in PD; novel age-associated oligodendrocyte subtype with chaperone-mediated autophagy/protein folding programs compromised in PD; cis-element links for PD DEGs
notes: VERIFIED: 31 donors = 9 young + 8 aged controls + 14 PD; 69,289 nuclei; accessions (PMC). n_ctrl counts young+aged.

title: Characterization of altered molecular mechanisms in Parkinson's disease through cell type-resolved multiomics analyses
main_conclusions_short: Cell type annotation of 128,724 cREs; PD-dysregulated cREs linked via 3D contacts to 656 target genes incl. GWAS genes; altered regulation in DA neurons, oligodendrocytes and microglia; 3830 PD DEGs by pseudobulk
notes: VERIFIED: nuclei counts, accession, UCSD ADRC source (PMC). Donor numbers in table S1 not extracted -> NA. Integrates Agarwal 2020 controls.

title: Human striatal glia differentially contribute to AD- and PD-specific neurodegeneration
main_conclusions_short: Striatal astrocyte/microglia/oligodendrocyte subpopulations differ between AD and PD; disease-specific glial states (e.g., Micr-1 APOE/B2M/TYROBP); glia differentially contribute to AD- vs PD-specific neurodegeneration
notes: VERIFIED: accession, putamen ctrl/AD/PD (PMC). INFERRED: 4/4/4 split from 12 GEO samples and Bae 2023 reanalysis of 8 ctrl+PD samples (19,076 nuclei). Senior author Zhao. Interactive browser epigenome.wustl.edu.

title: Oligodendroglia vulnerability in the human dorsal striatum in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: Four PD-associated oligodendroglial subclasses (PDAOPCs, PDAO-1/2/3) with heat-shock response; PDAO-2 immune-like; putamen most affected with reduced MBP correlating with PDAO ratios; spatial heat-shock up / myelination down
notes: VERIFIED: 27 ctrl/36 PD, accessions (PMC; MGH brain bank).

title: The spatial landscape of glial pathology and T cell response in Parkinson's disease substantia nigra
main_conclusions_short: CD8+ T cells enriched and clonally expanded in PD SN with alpha-synuclein-like TCRs; CD44+ astrocytes increased and spatially co-localize with T cells; CD44 knockdown dampens astrocyte inflammatory signature
notes: VERIFIED: SN 13 PD/15 ctrl, cingulate 10 PD/8 ctrl, Visium 5/5, accessions (PMC). PD group includes PD/DLBD. Senior author Al-Dalahmah (Columbia).

title: Activation of transposable elements is linked to a region- and cell type-specific interferon response in Parkinson's disease
accession: ASAP CRN Cloud collection (Jakobsson team); code Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.17434560
main_conclusions_short: TE (L1/ERV) expression increased in microglia and neurons of PD SN and putamen but not amygdala/PFC; TE activation correlates with innate/interferon response; interferon-TE link confirmed in hPSC microglia/neurons
notes: VERIFIED: 43 donors (25 PD, 18 ctrl, Cambridge Brain Bank), nuclei, ASAP CRN access (PMC). Likely shares donors/data with graziano2025 (Cambridge, ASAP jakobsson collection).

title: Single-nucleus brain transcriptomics reveals microglia dysfunction in multiple system atrophy
main_conclusions_short: PD striatum shows abundant MHC-II+ proinflammatory microglia and more homeostatic astrocytes; MSA lacks activated microglia and has more reactive astrocytes; compromised oligodendrocyte signaling in MSA
notes: VERIFIED: 7 MSA/12 PD/10 ctrl, nuclei, accessions (PMC). Processed download from SCP not confirmed.

title: A multi-region single nucleus transcriptomic atlas of Parkinson's disease
regions: DMNX (dorsal motor nucleus of vagus); GPi (medial globus pallidus); primary motor cortex; DLPFC; primary visual cortex
accession: AMP PD Knowledge Platform release 4; CELLxGENE d5d0df8f
data_access: controlled (AMP-PD DUA) / processed open on CELLxGENE
main_conclusions_short: Data descriptor: 100 donors across PD Braak spectrum, 5 regions, 10x 3' v3.1 with hashing; QC and major cell-type annotation; no disease conclusions
notes: VERIFIED (PMC + CELLxGENE). First author listed in PubMed as 'N M' = Prashant N M; senior Roussos/Fullard (Mount Sinai). Data descriptor only; analysis in clarence2025.

title: A Transcriptomic Roadmap of Parkinson's Disease Progression at Single Cell Resolution
regions: DMNX; GPi; primary motor cortex; DLPFC; primary visual cortex (AMP-PD cohort of nm2024)
accession: AMP PD Knowledge Platform; CELLxGENE d5d0df8f
main_conclusions_short: Convergent upregulation of stress programs (UPR, DNA damage repair, autophagy) across cell types with HSF1/MYC/FOXO3 regulators; PD GWAS-enriched TF networks in microglia and neurons; transcriptomic pathology score shows early-stage changes; myeloid trajectory across Braak stages
notes: VERIFIED: 97 donors, 2,092,520 nuclei, AMP-PD (PMC preprint). PD/ctrl split among 97 inferred from parent cohort (75/25 of 100). Same data as nm2024 and kim2026 (Levin, long-read SV + snRNA, 2 regions) - not separate rows.

title: Massive-scale single-nucleus multi-omics identifies novel rare noncoding drivers of Parkinson's disease
regions: SN; putamen; cingulate gyrus; middle temporal gyrus; cerebellum
accession: IGVF Data Portal; CELLxGENE 16876983; PRJNA1418141; WGS via GP2/AMP-PD
main_conclusions_short: Cell type-specific PD features across 5 regions incl. compositional changes in cingulate progressing with stage; cell-type caQTL/eQTL maps; ML-prioritized rare noncoding variants associated with sporadic PD; predicted drivers in familial PD
notes: VERIFIED: 80 PD/21 ctrl, regions (CELLxGENE tissue labels), data portals (PMC preprint). Senior author Corces (Gladstone). Seed 'Menon et al. 2026 multiregion atlas'.

title: Modeling cis-regulatory variation in human brain enhancers across a large Parkinson's Disease cohort
modality: multiome; snRNA; snATAC (+ long-read WGS, methylation)
accession: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19034709 (per-donor raw+processed); ASAP CRN Cloud (pending); SCope ASAP_brain; WGS EGA EGAS50000000921/EGAS50000001689
main_conclusions_short: 53,841 cis-acting variants modulating cell type-specific enhancer accessibility (caQTL/meQTL/ASCA) in SN and cortex; sequence-to-function models predict variant effects; most variants disrupt cell type-specific TF binding sites
notes: VERIFIED: 190 donors (115 ctrl, 75 PD); SN subset 90 ctrl/50 PD (PMC preprint). Senior Aerts (ASAP team). Primarily a genetics/QTL paper; few case-control claims.

title: RNA- and ATAC-sequencing Reveals a Unique CD83+ Microglial Population Focally Depleted in Parkinson's Disease
main_conclusions_short: CD83+/HIF1A+ microglial subpopulation (M8) strongly depleted in PD SN, tracking regional neurodegeneration; TMEM163-high proinflammatory microglia (M5/M6) enriched in PD SN; M8 enriched for antigen-presentation/heat-shock genes
notes: VERIFIED: 19 PD/14 ctrl in SN; other regions PD donors only (85 samples) (bioRxiv full text). Data availability statement not found; no peer-reviewed version found in PubMed (Oct 2026). Senior Przedborski/Bradshaw (Columbia).

title: A deep cellular atlas of the human ventral substantia nigra in Parkinson's identifies a genetic and molecular overlap with insulin resistance
main_conclusions_short: Genetic risk converges on AGTR1+ DA neurons and perineuronal oligodendrocytes, both reduced in PD; AGTR1+ neurons are a metabolically stressed state (RAS/MAPK activation, oxidative stress) not a subtype; PD-T2D/insulin resistance genetic overlap (AGTR1, TCF7L2 loci)
notes: VERIFIED: GEO overall design (6 PD Braak5-6 + 3 PD Braak3-4, 4 iLBD, 7 ctrl), processed matrix + metadata files on GEO. GEO links PMID 42645327 which is an unrelated paper (GEO error). Earlier version titled with 'Type 2 Diabetes' (PMC12728104). Webber/Wade-Martins/Parkkinen (Oxford/Cardiff).

title: A molecular atlas of cell-type specific signatures in the parkinsonian striatum
accession: ASAP CRN Cloud collection 'jakobsson-20'; code Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15065317
main_conclusions_short: SPNs show largest PD transcriptional change, matrix iSPNs most affected; eccentric SPNs and CHST9+ dSPNs resilient; astrocytes and microglia most affected glia; pseudotime places SPN changes early, astrocyte later; overlap with 6-OHDA/MitoPark mouse models
notes: VERIFIED (bioRxiv full text via WebFetch): Cambridge Brain Bank, 23 PD/11 ctrl, ASAP CRN. Senior Meletis (Karolinska). Not in PubMed. Likely overlaps donors with garza2026.

title: Spatial multi-omics identifies early synaptic pruning and context-specific dopaminergic vulnerability in synucleinopathies
main_conclusions_short: alpha-syn seeding correlates with DA neuron loss in PD-spectrum but not AD+LBP; in iLBD, C1QC up and inhibitory synaptic markers lost before overt SN Lewy pathology; early complement-associated synapse remodeling
notes: VERIFIED: post-QC 22 cases (6 ctrl, 7 iLBD, 9 PD) for spatial clustering; Visium (PMC). AD/AD+LBP counts not extracted. Processed availability inferred from statement (fastq only).

title: Distinct spatial transcriptomic patterns of substantia Nigra in Parkinson disease and Parkinsonian subtype of multiple system atrophy
main_conclusions_short: PD and MSA-P SNpc show downregulated ribosomal translation, mitochondrial and UPS pathways; MSA-P dorsomedial quadrant linked to antigen presentation; quadrant-specific signatures
notes: VERIFIED: 2/2/2 donors, figshare (PMC). Platform inferred as GeoMx from 'in-situ hybridization ROI' description - verify. Not single-cell resolution; correction PMID 41189013.

title: Single-cell profiling of limbic excitatory neurons reveals dysregulation of metabolic pathways in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: Microglia increased with activated states in PD amygdala; metabolic-pathway perturbations incl. TFEB upregulation in excitatory but not inhibitory neurons; mTOR-TFEB activation raises GPNMB/SNCA in iPSC neurons
notes: VERIFIED from GEO records only (public Apr/Oct 2026; contributors Glock, Watanabe, Smith, Friedman, Mordes - Genentech). No publication/preprint located; title is GEO series title. Late-onset PD.

title: Adult human subventricular zone microglia promote a pro-neurogenic niche for neuronal progenitors in Parkinson's disease
regions: subventricular zone (lateral ventricle wall, adjacent caudate)
main_conclusions_short: SVZ microglia show disease-dependent signatures in PD and AD; PD SVZ microglia supernatant increases NSC proliferation/neuronal differentiation; NR4A2 proposed to drive pro-neurogenic microglia
notes: PARTLY VERIFIED: abstract + GEO (4 samples in GSE279821). Donor numbers unknown. Peripheral to scope (sorted microglia, SVZ).

title: A neuropeptide receptor-enriched transcriptional state characterizes resilient dopaminergic neurons in Parkinson's disease
main_conclusions_short: Surviving PD DA neurons carry higher neuropeptide-receptor (NPR) burden; low-NPR DANs express SOX6/ALDH1A1/AGTR1 and PD genetic risk; complex I subunits reduced in low-NPR tier; PRLR and CRHR1 nominated as resilience mediators
notes: UNCERTAIN: abstract only (no PMC). Unclear whether new data or reanalysis of public SN datasets (e.g., kamath2022) - likely reanalysis; verify before inclusion as primary study.

title: Single-cell eQTL mapping reveals convergent glial-neuronal risk architecture in Parkinson's disease
accession: Key Resource Table (Table S11); uses syn2759792, syn9702085
main_conclusions_short: 125 functional PD risk genes for 50 GWAS loci; 51% of risk genes regulated in glia, especially oligodendrocytes/OPCs; convergence on glial-neuronal vesiculopathy network
notes: UNCERTAIN: mostly meta-analysis of existing snRNA cohorts; methods mention 10x loading, so some new SN/cortex snRNA may have been generated (Scherzer lab, ASAP). Case/control numbers not extracted.

title: ASAP CRN Human Postmortem-derived Brain Sequencing Collection (PMDBS), harmonized in Allen ABC Atlas
regions: 9 regions incl. midbrain/SN, putamen, cingulate, MTG, motor cortex (team-dependent)
accession: ASAP CRN Cloud (cloud.parkinsonsroadmap.org); Allen ABC Atlas
main_conclusions_short: Harmonized resource from teams Hafler, Lee, Jakobsson, Scherzer, Hardy; not a single study
notes: Resource row, not a study. Contains data underlying garza2026, graziano2025, sigalova2026 and possibly unpublished team datasets (Hafler, Lee, Hardy). Region list and donor split not verified.
